title: feat(InstantSearch): switch to DerivedHelper only
body:
This PR switches the `.search` implementation to `. searchOnlyWithDerivedHelpers`. We override the `.search` method to keep the exact same API for the consumer of the libraries. Only the module `InstantSearch` is impacted by the change. 

This switch allow a full control on each request made by the Helper, which is not the case with the regular `.search` function. We're able to alter the request without any impact on the internal state of the Helper (via the derivation function). Now the "main" Helper is only in charge of managing the state, the derived one is in charge of the requests.
